def: a word you say when you meet someone
example: Hello! How are you?
note_ru: «Hello» подходит и для друзей, и для незнакомых людей.
note_en: "Hello" works both with friends and with strangers.

def: a short, friendly way to say hello
example: Hi, Tom! Nice to see you.
note_ru: Неформальное приветствие, для друзей и знакомых.
note_en: An informal greeting for friends and people you know.

def: a word you say when you leave
example: Goodbye! See you tomorrow.

def: a short, friendly way to say goodbye
example: Bye, Anna! Have a good day.

def: what you say to people in the morning
example: Good morning, Mr Brown!
note_ru: Говорят примерно до 12 часов дня.
note_en: Used until about 12 noon.

def: what you say to people after twelve o'clock
example: Good afternoon! Can I help you?
example_ru: Добрый день! Я могу вам помочь?
note_ru: Говорят примерно с 12 до 17–18 часов.
note_en: Used from about 12 noon until 5 or 6 pm.

def: what you say to people in the evening
example: Good evening! Welcome to our hotel.
example_ru: Добрый вечер! Добро пожаловать в наш отель.

def: what you say before you go to bed
example: Good night, Mum! See you tomorrow.
note_ru: Это прощание перед сном, а не приветствие вечером.
note_en: This is a goodbye before going to bed, not an evening greeting.

def: you say it when you ask for something
example: A cup of tea, please.
note_ru: «Please» — только при просьбе; в ответ на «спасибо» говорят «you're welcome».
note_en: "Please" is only for requests; the reply to "thank you" is "you're welcome".

def: what you say when someone helps you
example: Thank you for your help.
note_ru: «Thank you very much» — большое спасибо.
note_en: "Thank you very much" is the stronger version.

def: a short, friendly way to say thank you
example: Thanks, Dad! I like this book.
example_ru: Спасибо, папа! Мне нравится эта книга.

def: what you say after someone says thank you
example: – Thank you! – You're welcome.
note_ru: В ответ на «thank you» говорят «you're welcome», а не «please».
note_en: The reply to "thank you" is "you're welcome", not "please".

def: what you say when you do something bad
example: Sorry, I am late.
note_ru: «Sorry?» с вопросительной интонацией — «Простите, не расслышал».
note_en: "Sorry?" with a rising tone means "Sorry, I didn't catch that".

def: what you say before you ask someone something
example: Excuse me, where is the station?
note_ru: «Excuse me» говорят, чтобы привлечь внимание; «sorry» — когда извиняются.
note_en: Say "excuse me" to get someone's attention; say "sorry" to apologise.

def: the word you say when you agree
example: – Do you like tea? – Yes, I do.
note_ru: В разговоре часто говорят «yeah» (/jeə/).
note_en: In conversation people often say "yeah" (/jeə/).

def: the word you say when you do not agree
example: No, thank you. I am not hungry.

def: a word that means yes or all right
example: – Can you come at six? – Okay.
example_ru: – Ты можешь прийти в шесть? – Хорошо.
note_ru: Часто пишут просто OK.
note_en: Often written simply as OK.

def: the word that people call you
example: My name is Anna.
note_ru: «What's your name?» — Как тебя зовут?
note_en: "What's your name?" is the usual way to ask someone's name.

def: a question you ask when you meet someone
example: Hi, Ben! How are you?
note_ru: Обычный ответ: «I'm fine, thanks. And you?»
note_en: The usual answer: "I'm fine, thanks. And you?"

def: what you say when you meet someone new
example: I'm Tom. Nice to meet you!
note_ru: Ответ: «Nice to meet you too».
note_en: The reply: "Nice to meet you too".

def: a way to say goodbye to a friend
example: I'm going home now. See you later!
note_ru: Коротко: «See you!»
note_en: Short form: "See you!"

def: what you say when someone comes to your place
example: Welcome to London!

def: a word before a man's name
example: This is Mr Smith, my teacher.
note_ru: В британском английском после Mr точку обычно не ставят.
note_en: In British English there is usually no full stop after Mr.

def: a word before the name of a woman with a husband
example: Mrs Green lives in this house.
example_ru: Миссис Грин живёт в этом доме.
note_ru: Для любой женщины, замужем или нет, используют Ms (/mɪz/).
note_en: For any woman, married or not, use Ms (/mɪz/).

def: good, well or OK
example: – How are you? – I'm fine, thanks.
note_ru: «Fine» также значит «хороший, прекрасный»: a fine day.
note_en: "Fine" also means "good, excellent": a fine day.

def: the number 0
example: My phone number has a zero in it.
example_ru: В моём номере телефона есть ноль.
note_ru: В номерах телефона ноль часто читают как «oh» (/əʊ/).
note_en: In phone numbers zero is often read as "oh" (/əʊ/).

def: the number 1
example: I have one brother.

def: the number 2
example: I have two cats.
note_ru: Звучит так же, как «to» и «too».
note_en: Sounds the same as "to" and "too".

def: the number 3
example: There are three apples on the table.
note_ru: Звук /θ/ — язык между зубами, не «с» и не «ф».
note_en: The /θ/ sound: put your tongue between your teeth; it is not /s/ or /f/.

def: the number 4
example: We have four chairs.
note_ru: Звучит так же, как «for».
note_en: Sounds the same as "for".

def: the number 5
example: The lesson starts at five.

def: the number 6
example: Dinner is at six.

def: the number 7
example: A week has seven days.

def: the number 8
example: I go to work at eight.
example_ru: Я иду на работу в восемь.
note_ru: Звучит так же, как «ate» (ел).
note_en: Sounds the same as "ate" (past of eat).

def: the number 9
example: School starts at nine.

def: the number 10
example: I have ten pounds.

def: the number 11
example: My sister is eleven.

def: the number 12
example: A year has twelve months.

def: the number 13
example: My brother is thirteen.
note_ru: Ударение в thirteen на втором слоге, в thirty — на первом.
note_en: The stress in thirteen is on the second syllable, in thirty on the first.

def: the number 20
example: There are twenty students in my class.
note_ru: 21 = twenty-one, 22 = twenty-two и т. д.
note_en: 21 = twenty-one, 22 = twenty-two, and so on.

def: the number 30
example: My uncle is thirty.

def: the number 40
example: My dad is forty.
note_ru: Пишется forty, а не fourty.
note_en: It is spelled forty, not fourty.

def: the number 50
example: This is bus number fifty.

def: the number 100
example: There are a hundred people here.
note_ru: Говорят «a hundred» или «one hundred»; 200 — two hundred (без -s).
note_en: Say "a hundred" or "one hundred"; 200 is two hundred (no -s).

def: the number 1000
example: This car costs ten thousand pounds.
example_ru: Эта машина стоит десять тысяч фунтов.
note_ru: Говорят «a thousand» или «one thousand».
note_en: Say "a thousand" or "one thousand".

def: number one; before all the others
example: Monday is the first day of the week.
note_ru: Коротко пишут 1st.
note_en: Short form: 1st.

def: number two; after the first
example: This is my second cup of coffee.
note_ru: Коротко пишут 2nd; «a second» — также «секунда».
note_en: Short form: 2nd; "a second" is also a unit of time.

def: number three; after the second
example: My flat is on the third floor.
note_ru: Коротко пишут 3rd.
note_en: Short form: 3rd.

def: a word like one, two or three
example: What is your phone number?

def: to say numbers one after the other
example: My son can count to ten.
example_ru: Мой сын умеет считать до десяти.
note_ru: Считать «до» — count to ten.
note_en: Count "to" a number: count to ten.

def: your mother, father, brothers and sisters
example: I love my family.

def: a woman who has a child
example: My mother is a doctor.

def: a man who has a child
example: My father works in a bank.

def: a short, friendly word for mother
example: Mum, where is my bag?
note_ru: В американском английском — mom.
note_en: In American English: mom.

def: a short, friendly word for father
example: My dad likes football.

def: a mother or a father
example: My parents live in Moscow.
note_ru: Обычно во множественном числе: parents — родители.
note_en: Usually plural: parents.

def: a boy or man who is someone's child
example: They have a son and a daughter.
note_ru: Звучит так же, как sun (солнце).
note_en: Sounds the same as sun.

def: a girl or woman who is someone's child
example: Her daughter is five.
note_ru: Буквы gh не читаются.
note_en: The letters gh are silent.

def: a boy or man with the same parents as you
example: My brother is tall.

def: a girl or woman with the same parents as you
example: I have two sisters.

def: the mother of your mother or father
example: My grandmother makes good cakes.
note_ru: В семье говорят grandma или granny.
note_en: In the family people say grandma or granny.

def: the father of your mother or father
example: My grandfather likes to read.
note_ru: В семье говорят grandpa.
note_en: In the family people say grandpa.

def: a very young child
example: The baby is sleeping.

def: a young boy or girl
example: The child is playing in the garden.
note_ru: Множественное число — children (дети), читается /ˈtʃɪldrən/.
note_en: The plural is children, pronounced /ˈtʃɪldrən/.

def: a young man or a child who is not a girl
example: The boy is reading a book.

def: a young woman or a child who is not a boy
example: The girl has a red hat.

def: an adult person who is not a woman
example: That man is my teacher.
note_ru: Множественное число — men (/men/).
note_en: The plural is men (/men/).

def: an adult person who is not a man
example: This woman is my mother.
note_ru: Множественное число women читается /ˈwɪmɪn/.
note_en: The plural women is pronounced /ˈwɪmɪn/.

def: men, women and children
example: There are many people in the park.
note_ru: People — уже множественное число: people are, а не people is.
note_en: People is already plural: people are, not people is.

def: one man, woman or child
example: She is a nice person.
note_ru: Множественное число обычно people, а не persons.
note_en: The usual plural is people, not persons.

def: a person you like and know well
example: Anna is my good friend.
note_ru: Буква i не читается: /frend/.
note_en: The letter i is silent: /frend/.

def: a man who has a wife
example: Her husband is a teacher.

def: a woman who has a husband
example: My wife likes coffee.
note_ru: Множественное число — wives.
note_en: The plural is wives.

def: the brother of your mother or father
example: My uncle lives in London.

def: the sister of your mother or father
example: My aunt has three cats.
note_ru: В британском произношении звучит как «ант», в американском — как «энт».
note_en: In British English it sounds like "aunt" /ɑːnt/, in American English like "ant" /ænt/.

def: things that people eat
example: We buy food at the supermarket.
note_ru: Обычно без артикля и без множественного числа.
note_en: Usually used without an article and without a plural.

def: a food you cut and eat with butter
example: I eat bread with cheese.
note_ru: Неисчисляемое: a piece of bread — кусок хлеба.
note_en: Uncountable: a piece of bread.

def: a yellow food made from milk
example: I put butter on my bread.

def: a yellow or white food made from milk
example: This cheese is very good.

def: a round food that comes from a chicken
example: I eat an egg for breakfast.

def: a white drink that comes from a cow
example: Children drink milk.

def: a drink with no colour; it is in rivers
example: Can I have a glass of water?

def: a hot drink; people in Britain love it
example: I drink tea with milk.

def: a hot brown drink
example: I drink coffee in the morning.
note_ru: «A coffee» — чашка кофе.
note_en: "A coffee" means a cup of coffee.

def: a drink made from fruit
example: Orange juice, please.

def: a sweet white food; you put it in tea
example: Do you take sugar in your tea?
note_ru: Читается с «ш»: /ˈʃʊɡə/.
note_en: Pronounced with "sh": /ˈʃʊɡə/.

def: a white thing you put on food
example: This soup needs salt.

def: food from animals
example: I don't eat meat.
note_ru: Звучит так же, как meet (встречать).
note_en: Sounds the same as meet.

def: a bird that people eat; its meat
example: We have chicken and rice for dinner.
example_ru: На ужин у нас курица с рисом.
note_ru: Мясо — без артикля: I like chicken.
note_en: As meat, no article: I like chicken.

def: an animal that lives in water; its meat
example: My cat likes fish.
note_ru: Множественное число — тоже fish.
note_en: The plural is also fish.

def: small white food that you cook in water
example: I eat rice with fish.

def: hot food with a lot of water in it
example: This soup is very hot.

def: apples, bananas and oranges are fruit
example: Fruit is good for you.
note_ru: Обычно без множественного числа: I like fruit — я люблю фрукты.
note_en: Usually no plural: I like fruit.

def: a round fruit with red or green skin
example: I eat an apple every day.

def: a long yellow fruit
example: My son eats a banana every morning.
example_ru: Мой сын каждое утро ест банан.

def: a round sweet fruit with thick skin
example: Oranges are sweet.
note_ru: Также цвет: an orange hat — оранжевая шапка.
note_en: Also a colour: an orange hat.

def: a plant that you eat, like a potato
example: Eat your vegetables!
note_ru: Читается в три слога: /ˈvedʒ-tə-bl/.
note_en: Pronounced in three syllables: /ˈvedʒ-tə-bl/.

def: a white vegetable that grows under the ground
example: We eat potatoes with meat.
note_ru: Множественное число — potatoes (с -es).
note_en: The plural is potatoes (with -es).

def: a sweet food you eat at a party
example: My mum makes a cake on Sundays.
example_ru: Моя мама печёт торт по воскресеньям.

def: bread with cheese or meat in it
example: I have a sandwich for lunch.

def: a building where a family lives
example: We live in a small house.
note_ru: Множественное число houses читается /ˈhaʊzɪz/.
note_en: The plural houses is pronounced /ˈhaʊzɪz/.

def: the place where you live
example: I go home at six.
note_ru: «Go home» — без предлога to; «at home» — дома.
note_en: "Go home" has no preposition to; "at home" means in your home.

def: rooms where you live in a big building
example: Our flat is on the second floor.
note_ru: В американском английском — apartment. В Британии этажи считают с ground floor, поэтому second floor — это третий этаж.
note_en: In American English: apartment. In Britain floors are counted from the ground floor, so the second floor is two levels above the street.

def: a part of a house with walls and a door
example: My room is small.

def: the room where you cook
example: Mum is in the kitchen.

def: the room where you sleep
example: Our flat has two bedrooms.

def: the room where you wash
example: The bathroom is next to the kitchen.
note_ru: В США bathroom часто значит и «туалет».
note_en: In the US, bathroom often also means "toilet".

def: the room where you sit and watch TV
example: We watch TV in the living room.

def: you open it to go into a room
example: Please close the door.

def: you look out of it; it is made of glass
example: Open the window, please.

def: the side of a room
example: There is a picture on the wall.

def: the part of a room you walk on
example: The cat is sleeping on the floor.
note_ru: Также «этаж»: в Британии ground floor — первый этаж, first floor — второй.
note_en: Also a level of a building: in Britain the ground floor is at street level and the first floor is the one above it.

def: you eat at it; it has four legs
example: The food is on the table.

def: you sit on it
example: Sit on this chair.

def: you sleep in it
example: I go to bed at ten.
note_ru: «Go to bed» — ложиться спать, «in bed» — в постели (без артикля).
note_en: "Go to bed" means to go to sleep; "in bed" (no article) means lying in your bed.

def: a long soft chair for two or three people
example: We sit on the sofa and watch TV.
example_ru: Мы сидим на диване и смотрим телевизор.

def: it gives light in a room
example: There is a lamp next to my bed.
example_ru: Рядом с моей кроватью стоит лампа.

def: you watch films on it
example: We have a big television.
note_ru: Коротко — TV: watch TV — смотреть телевизор.
note_en: Short form: TV. watch TV.

def: a cold box for food
example: The milk is in the fridge.

def: you drink tea or coffee from it
example: I want a cup of tea.

def: you put food on it
example: Put the fish on the plate.

def: you drink water or juice from it
example: A glass of water, please.
note_ru: Glasses — также «очки».
note_en: Glasses also means spectacles.

def: you cut food with it
example: I need a knife for the bread.
note_ru: Буква k не читается; множественное число — knives.
note_en: The letter k is silent; the plural is knives.

def: you open a door with it
example: Where are my keys?

def: a place with flowers and grass near a house
example: The children play in the garden.
note_ru: В американском английском — yard.
note_en: In American English: yard.

def: to leave your bed in the morning
example: I get up at seven.
forms: get up – got up – got up
note_ru: Get up — встать с кровати; wake up — проснуться.
note_en: Get up means to get out of bed; wake up means to stop sleeping.

def: to stop sleeping
example: I wake up at six every day.
example_ru: Я просыпаюсь в шесть каждый день.
forms: wake up – woke up – woken up

def: to clean something with water
example: I wash my hands before dinner.
note_ru: Умываться — wash your face; мыть посуду — wash the dishes.
note_en: Wash your face; wash the dishes.

def: to wash your body under water
example: I have a shower in the morning.
forms: have a shower – had a shower – had a shower
note_ru: В американском английском — take a shower.
note_en: In American English: take a shower.

def: to clean your teeth or hair with a brush
example: I brush my teeth two times a day.
example_ru: Я чищу зубы два раза в день.
note_ru: Brush your teeth — чистить зубы; brush your hair — причёсываться.
note_en: Brush your teeth; brush your hair.

def: to put on your clothes
example: I get dressed and have breakfast.
forms: get dressed – got dressed – got dressed

def: the food you eat in the morning
example: I have eggs for breakfast.
note_ru: Завтракать — have breakfast, без артикля.
note_en: Have breakfast, with no article.

def: the food you eat in the middle of the day
example: We have lunch at one o'clock.
note_ru: Lunch — дневной приём пищи, обычно лёгкий.
note_en: Lunch is the midday meal, usually a light one.

def: the big meal you eat in the evening
example: Dinner is at seven.
note_ru: В Британии dinner — главный приём пищи, чаще вечером.
note_en: In Britain dinner is the main meal, usually in the evening.

def: to make hot food
example: My dad cooks dinner on Saturdays.
example_ru: Мой папа готовит ужин по субботам.
note_ru: A cook — повар.
note_en: A cook is a person who cooks.

def: to take away dirt from something
example: I clean my room every Saturday.
example_ru: Я убираю свою комнату каждую субботу.
note_ru: Clean the house — убирать дом; clean the window — мыть окно.
note_en: Clean the house; clean the window.

def: to get into your bed to sleep
example: I go to bed at eleven.
forms: go to bed – went to bed – gone to bed
note_ru: Без артикля: go to bed, а не go to the bed.
note_en: No article: go to bed, not go to the bed.

def: to rest with your eyes closed at night
example: I sleep eight hours.
note_ru: Sleep well! — Спокойной ночи (спи хорошо)!
note_en: Sleep well! is a friendly thing to say at bedtime.

def: to do a job
example: My mother works in a hospital.
note_ru: Work — также существительное: go to work — идти на работу.
note_en: Work is also a noun: go to work.

def: to stop working and relax
example: I rest after lunch.
note_ru: Отдыхать в отпуске — be on holiday, не rest.
note_en: For a vacation, say be on holiday, not rest.

def: to leave your home to have fun
example: We go out on Friday evenings.
example_ru: Мы выходим в свет по вечерам в пятницу.
forms: go out – went out – gone out
note_ru: Go out with friends — проводить время с друзьями вне дома.
note_en: Go out with friends means to spend time with them away from home.

def: to come back to the place where you live
example: I come home at six.
forms: come home – came home – come home
note_ru: Без предлога: come home, а не come to home.
note_en: No preposition: come home, not come to home.

def: to speak to someone on the phone
example: I call my mum every evening.
note_ru: Call me! — Позвони мне! (без предлога).
note_en: Call me! (no preposition).

def: to go and see a person or a place
example: We visit my grandmother on Sundays.
note_ru: Без предлога: visit a friend, а не visit to a friend.
note_en: No preposition: visit a friend, not visit to a friend.

def: to go on foot
example: I walk to school.
note_ru: Go for a walk — идти на прогулку; walk the dog — выгуливать собаку.
note_en: Go for a walk; walk the dog.

def: to go very fast on your feet
example: I run in the park every morning.
example_ru: Я бегаю в парке каждое утро.

def: to begin
example: Work starts at nine.

def: to come to the end of something
example: I finish work at five.

def: to rest and feel good
example: In the evening I relax and watch TV.
example_ru: Вечером я отдыхаю и смотрю телевизор.

def: on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and all days
example: I drink coffee every day.
note_ru: Пишется раздельно: every day. Everyday (слитно) — прилагательное «повседневный».
note_en: Written as two words: every day. Everyday (one word) is an adjective meaning "ordinary, daily".

def: hours, minutes, days and years
example: What time is it?
note_ru: «What time is it?» — Сколько времени?
note_en: "What time is it?" is how you ask the time.

def: sixty minutes
example: The film is two hours long.
note_ru: Буква h не читается: an hour.
note_en: The letter h is silent: an hour.

def: sixty seconds; there are sixty in an hour
example: Wait a minute, please.

def: twenty-four hours
example: Sunday is my favourite day.

def: seven days
example: I work five days a week.
example_ru: Я работаю пять дней в неделю.

def: about thirty days; a year has twelve
example: We go to the sea next month.
example_ru: В следующем месяце мы едем на море.

def: twelve months
example: I am twenty years old.
note_ru: Возраст: I am 20 years old или просто I am 20.
note_en: Age: I am 20 years old, or simply I am 20.

def: this day
example: Today is Monday.

def: the day after today
example: See you tomorrow!

def: the day before today
example: Yesterday was Sunday.

def: the first part of the day
example: I drink tea in the morning.
note_ru: Утром — in the morning (с предлогом in).
note_en: In the morning (with the preposition in).

def: the part of the day before night
example: We watch TV in the evening.

def: the time when it is dark and people sleep
example: I sleep at night.
note_ru: Ночью — at night (не in the night).
note_en: At night (not in the night).

def: the first day of the week
example: I go to work on Monday.
example_ru: В понедельник я иду на работу.
note_ru: Дни недели пишутся с большой буквы; «в понедельник» — on Monday.
note_en: Days of the week start with a capital letter; on Monday.

def: the day after Monday
example: On Tuesday I have an English lesson.
example_ru: Во вторник у меня урок английского.

def: the day after Tuesday
example: Wednesday is in the middle of the week.
note_ru: Первая d не читается: /ˈwenzdeɪ/.
note_en: The first d is silent: /ˈwenzdeɪ/.

def: the day after Wednesday
example: We play football on Thursday.
example_ru: В четверг мы играем в футбол.

def: the last day of the working week
example: I love Friday!

def: the first day of the weekend
example: On Saturday we go shopping.
example_ru: В субботу мы ходим за покупками.

def: the day after Saturday; people do not work
example: On Sunday I visit my parents.

def: Saturday and Sunday
example: What do you do at the weekend?
note_ru: В Британии — at the weekend, в США — on the weekend.
note_en: In Britain at the weekend, in the US on the weekend.

def: the first month of the year
example: It is cold in January.
note_ru: Месяцы пишутся с большой буквы; «в январе» — in January.
note_en: Months start with a capital letter; in January.

def: the last month of the year
example: My birthday is in December.

def: at this time
example: I am busy now.

def: you say it after the hour: six o'clock
example: It is three o'clock.
note_ru: Только с целыми часами: six o'clock, но half past six.
note_en: Only with whole hours: six o'clock, but half past six.

def: red, blue and green are colours
example: What colour is your car?
note_ru: В американском английском пишется color.
note_en: In American English it is spelled color.

def: the colour of blood or a tomato
example: I have a red car.

def: the colour of the sky on a sunny day
example: The sea is blue.
note_ru: Light blue — голубой, dark blue — синий.
note_en: Light blue and dark blue: Russian has two separate colour words here, English just adds light or dark.

def: the colour of grass
example: The apples are green.

def: the colour of the sun or a banana
example: Her dress is yellow.

def: the colour of the night
example: I have a black cat.
note_ru: Black coffee — кофе без молока.
note_en: Black coffee is coffee without milk.

def: the colour of milk or snow
example: The walls are white.
note_ru: White coffee — кофе с молоком.
note_en: White coffee is coffee with milk.

def: the colour of coffee or wood
example: My shoes are brown.
note_ru: Brown hair — каштановые (тёмные) волосы; brown eyes — карие глаза.
note_en: Brown hair; brown eyes.

def: the colour between black and white
example: The sky is grey today.
note_ru: В американском английском пишется gray.
note_en: In American English it is spelled gray.

def: a light red colour
example: My daughter likes pink.

def: things you wear, like shirts and trousers
example: I buy new clothes in summer.
note_ru: Всегда во множественном числе: clothes are. Одна вещь — a piece of clothing.
note_en: Always plural: clothes are. One item is a piece of clothing.

def: you wear it on the top part of your body
example: My dad wears a white shirt to work.
example_ru: Мой папа носит на работу белую рубашку.

def: a soft shirt with short arms
example: He wears a blue T-shirt.

def: you wear them on your legs
example: These trousers are too long.
note_ru: Только множественное число: a pair of trousers. В США — pants.
note_en: Plural only: a pair of trousers. In the US: pants.

def: a piece of clothes for women and girls
example: She has a beautiful red dress.

def: women wear it from the waist down
example: My sister wears a short skirt.
note_ru: Не путайте с shirt (рубашка).
note_en: Don't confuse it with shirt.

def: a short coat
example: Take your jacket, it is cold.

def: you wear it over your clothes when it is cold
example: I wear a warm coat in winter.

def: you wear it on your foot
example: I need new shoes.
note_ru: Обычно во множественном числе: a pair of shoes — пара обуви.
note_en: Usually plural: a pair of shoes.

def: you wear it on your foot, under your shoe
example: Where are my black socks?

def: you wear it on your head
example: She has a big pink hat.

def: blue trousers that many people wear
example: I wear jeans and a T-shirt.
note_ru: Только множественное число: a pair of jeans.
note_en: Plural only: a pair of jeans.

def: to have clothes on your body
example: She wears a green dress.
note_ru: Wear — только об одежде; носить в руках — carry.
note_en: Wear is only for clothes; for things in your hands use carry.

def: to start to wear clothes
example: Put on your coat, it is cold.
forms: put on – put on – put on
note_ru: Put on your shoes — надень ботинки; dress — одевать кого-то.
note_en: Put on your shoes; dress means to put clothes on someone.

def: to stop wearing clothes
example: Take off your shoes at the door.
forms: take off – took off – taken off

def: all of a person: head, arms, legs
example: Sport is good for your body.

def: the top part of your body with your eyes
example: I have a hat on my head.

def: the front of your head
example: I wash my face in the morning.

def: you see with it
example: She has blue eyes.
note_ru: Звучит так же, как I (я).
note_en: Sounds the same as I.

def: you hear with it
example: My ears are cold.

def: it is on your face; you smell with it
example: The dog has a black nose.

def: you eat and speak with it
example: Open your mouth, please.

def: it is white and in your mouth
example: I brush my teeth every day.
note_ru: Множественное число — teeth (/tiːθ/).
note_en: The plural is teeth (/tiːθ/).

def: it grows on your head
example: She has long black hair.
note_ru: Обычно в единственном числе: her hair is long, а не are.
note_en: Usually singular: her hair is long, not are.

def: the end of your arm; it has five fingers
example: Wash your hands before lunch.
note_ru: Hand — кисть, arm — вся рука до плеча.
note_en: Hand is the part at the end of your arm; arm is the whole limb up to the shoulder.

def: the long part of your body from your hand to your shoulder
example: My arm hurts.

def: you walk on it; you have two
example: The dog has four legs.
note_ru: Leg — нога от бедра до стопы; foot — ступня.
note_en: Leg goes from the hip to the ankle; foot is the part you stand on.

def: the end of your leg; you stand on it
example: My feet are cold.
note_ru: Множественное число — feet; on foot — пешком.
note_en: The plural is feet; on foot means walking.

def: the part of your body behind you
example: My back hurts.
note_ru: Также наречие «назад, обратно»: come back — вернуться.
note_en: Also an adverb meaning "back, in return": come back.

def: it is in your body and sends blood around
example: Sport is good for your heart.
note_ru: Читается /hɑːt/, как hard без d.
note_en: Pronounced /hɑːt/, like hard without the d.

def: the part of your body where food goes
example: I have a pain in my stomach.
note_ru: Читается /ˈstʌmək/ — ch как «к».
note_en: Pronounced /ˈstʌmək/: ch sounds like k.

def: a person who helps you when you are ill
example: I need to see a doctor.
note_ru: Go to the doctor's — пойти к врачу.
note_en: Go to the doctor's means to visit the doctor.

def: a place where doctors help ill people
example: My aunt works in a hospital.
note_ru: В Британии: in hospital (лежать в больнице) — без артикля.
note_en: In Britain: in hospital (as a patient), with no article.

def: not well; not healthy
example: I am ill today. I am in bed.
example_ru: Я сегодня болею. Я лежу в постели.
note_ru: Ill — более британское слово, sick — более американское.
note_en: Ill is more British, sick is more American.

def: ill; not well
example: He is sick and can't go to school.
example_ru: Он болен и не может пойти в школу.
note_ru: В Британии be sick — также «тошнить».
note_en: In Britain be sick also means "to vomit".

def: a pain in your head
example: I have a headache.
note_ru: «У меня болит голова» — I have a headache (с артиклем a).
note_en: I have a headache (with the article a).

def: you take it when you are ill
example: Take this medicine two times a day.
example_ru: Принимайте это лекарство два раза в день.
note_ru: Принимать лекарство — take medicine, а не drink.
note_en: Take medicine, not drink medicine.

def: to feel pain
example: My leg hurts.
note_ru: «У меня болит...» — My ... hurts.
note_en: To say a part of your body is in pain: My ... hurts.

def: to be happy, sad, ill or well
example: I feel good today.
note_ru: Без «себя»: I feel well, а не I feel myself.
note_en: No reflexive: I feel well, not I feel myself.

def: well; not ill
example: Fruit and vegetables are healthy.
example_ru: Фрукты и овощи полезны для здоровья.
note_ru: Healthy — здоровый (о человеке) и полезный (о еде).
note_en: Healthy describes a person in good health and also food that is good for you.

def: sun, rain, wind and snow
example: What is the weather like today?
note_ru: Без артикля a: nice weather — хорошая погода.
note_en: No article a: nice weather.

def: it is in the sky; it gives light and is hot
example: The sun is hot today.
note_ru: С артиклем the: the sun.
note_en: With the article the: the sun.

def: with a lot of sun
example: It is a sunny day.

def: water that falls from clouds
example: I don't like rain.

def: when water falls from the sky
example: It is raining now.
note_ru: «Идёт дождь» — it is raining (с it).
note_en: It is raining (with it).

def: soft white water that falls in winter
example: The children play in the snow.

def: when snow falls from the sky
example: It snows a lot in winter.
note_ru: «Идёт снег» — it is snowing.
note_en: It is snowing.

def: air that moves fast outside
example: There is a strong wind today.

def: with a lot of wind
example: It is windy. Take your hat.

def: a white or grey thing in the sky
example: There are big clouds in the sky.

def: with a lot of clouds
example: It is cloudy today.

def: very warm
example: It is very hot in summer.
note_ru: «Мне жарко» — I am hot, а не I am hotly.
note_en: I am hot, not I am hotly.

def: a little hot; nice and not cold
example: The weather is warm today.

def: not warm; like ice
example: It is cold in winter.
note_ru: «Мне холодно» — I am cold. A cold — простуда.
note_en: I am cold. A cold is also an illness.

def: a little cold
example: The evenings are cool in autumn.
note_ru: В разговоре cool — также «классный, крутой».
note_en: In conversation cool also means "great, awesome".

def: spring, summer, autumn or winter
example: Summer is my favourite season.

def: the season after winter
example: Flowers come out in spring.
note_ru: «Весной» — in spring (можно без артикля).
note_en: In spring (the article is optional).

def: the hot season of the year
example: We go to the sea in summer.

def: the season after summer
example: It rains a lot in autumn.
note_ru: В американском английском — fall.
note_en: In American English: fall.

def: the cold season of the year
example: In winter there is a lot of snow.

def: you see it over your head when you go out
example: The sky is blue today.
note_ru: С артиклем: the sky.
note_en: With the article: the sky.

def: you say how hot or cold it is in degrees
example: It is twenty degrees today.
note_ru: Минус пять — minus five или five degrees below zero.
note_en: Minus five, or five degrees below zero.

def: you hold it over your head when it rains
example: Take an umbrella, it is raining.

def: water that is very cold and hard
example: There is ice on the road.
note_ru: Ice cream — мороженое.
note_en: Ice cream is a frozen dessert.

def: very bad weather with strong wind and rain
example: There is a storm tonight.

def: a very big town, like London or Moscow
example: Moscow is a big city.
note_ru: City — большой город, town — небольшой.
note_en: City is a big town; town is smaller.

def: a place with streets, shops and houses
example: I live in a small town.
note_ru: Go to town — поехать в центр города (без артикля).
note_en: Go to town means to go to the town centre (no article).

def: a very small town in the country
example: My grandmother lives in a village.

def: a road in a town with houses on it
example: I live on this street.
note_ru: В Британии чаще in the street, в США — on the street.
note_en: In Britain more often in the street, in the US on the street.

def: cars drive on it from one place to another
example: There are many cars on the road.

def: a place where people keep their money
example: The bank opens at nine.
note_ru: Также «берег реки»: river bank.
note_en: Also the side of a river: river bank.

def: a big place in a town with trees and grass
example: We walk in the park on Sundays.
example_ru: По воскресеньям мы гуляем в парке.
note_ru: Также глагол: park the car — припарковать машину.
note_en: Also a verb: park the car.

def: a place where you get on a train or bus
example: The station is near my house.
note_ru: Train station — ж/д вокзал, bus station — автовокзал.
note_en: Train station; bus station.

def: a place where planes come and go
example: We go to the airport by taxi.
example_ru: Мы едем в аэропорт на такси.

def: a building where you sleep when you travel
example: We stay in a hotel near the sea.
example_ru: Мы живём в отеле у моря.
note_ru: Ударение на втором слоге: hoTEL.
note_en: The stress is on the second syllable: hoTEL.

def: a place where you pay to eat dinner
example: We eat at a restaurant on Fridays.
example_ru: По пятницам мы ужинаем в ресторане.
note_ru: Конечное t читается: /ˈrestrɒnt/.
note_en: The final t is pronounced: /ˈrestrɒnt/.

def: a small place where you drink coffee and eat cake
example: Let's meet at the café at five.
example_ru: Давай встретимся в кафе в пять.
note_ru: Часто пишут без значка: cafe.
note_en: Often written without the accent: cafe.

def: a big car for many people
example: I go to work by bus.
example_ru: Я езжу на работу на автобусе.
note_ru: «На автобусе» — by bus (без артикля).
note_en: By bus (no article).

def: it goes on rails and takes many people
example: The train to London leaves at ten.
example_ru: Поезд в Лондон отправляется в десять.

def: you drive it on the road; it has four wheels
example: My father has a new car.
note_ru: «На машине» — by car.
note_en: By car.

def: a car you pay to take you somewhere
example: Let's take a taxi to the station.
note_ru: Также cab.
note_en: Also cab.

def: it has two wheels; you ride it
example: I ride my bike to school.
example_ru: Я езжу в школу на велосипеде.
note_ru: Полная форма — bicycle (/ˈbaɪsɪkl/).
note_en: The full form is bicycle (/ˈbaɪsɪkl/).

def: it flies in the sky and takes people far away
example: The plane to Paris is at six.
note_ru: Полная форма — aeroplane; «на самолёте» — by plane.
note_en: The full form is aeroplane; by plane.

def: you buy it to go on a bus or train
example: Two tickets to London, please.

def: a picture of a town or country
example: I have a map of the city.
note_ru: Карта (игральная или банковская) — card.
note_en: A playing card or bank card is a card, not a map.

def: to make a car go
example: My mum drives to work.
example_ru: Моя мама ездит на работу на машине.
note_ru: Driver — водитель.
note_en: A driver is a person who drives.

def: to not go or move any more
example: The bus stops here.
note_ru: Bus stop — автобусная остановка.
note_en: A bus stop is where the bus stops.

def: the side where your heart is
example: The bank is on the left.
note_ru: Turn left — поверните налево; on the left — слева.
note_en: Turn left; on the left.

def: not left; the other side
example: The shop is on the right.
note_ru: Right также значит «правильный»: That's right! — Верно!
note_en: Right also means "correct": That's right!

def: the middle part of a town
example: The hotel is in the city centre.
note_ru: В американском английском пишется center.
note_en: In American English it is spelled center.

def: you pay with it when you buy things
example: I don't have any money.
note_ru: Единственное число: money is, а не money are.
note_en: Singular: money is, not money are.

def: a place where you buy things
example: The shop is open from nine to six.
example_ru: Магазин открыт с девяти до шести.
note_ru: В американском английском — store.
note_en: In American English: store.

def: a big shop where you buy food
example: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
example_ru: Я покупаю молоко и хлеб в супермаркете.

def: a place outside where people sell fruit and clothes
example: The market is open on Saturdays.

def: the money you pay for something
example: What is the price of this hat?
note_ru: Цена высокая или низкая: high / low price, не expensive price.
note_en: A price is high or low: a high / low price, not an expensive price.

def: not expensive; it costs little money
example: These shoes are very cheap.

def: it costs a lot of money
example: This car is too expensive.
note_ru: Дорогой (о человеке) — dear, не expensive.
note_en: For a person you love, say dear, not expensive.

def: to give money and get something
example: I buy bread every morning.
note_ru: Звучит так же, как bye и by.
note_en: Sounds the same as bye and by.

def: to give something and get money for it
example: This shop sells good coffee.
example_ru: В этом магазине продают хороший кофе.

def: to give money for something
example: Can I pay by card?
note_ru: Pay for something — платить за что-то.
note_en: Pay for something.

def: to have a price
example: This book costs ten pounds.
note_ru: How much does it cost? — Сколько это стоит?
note_en: How much does it cost?

def: money in Britain; £
example: A cup of coffee costs three pounds.
note_ru: £5 читается five pounds; в разговоре — quid.
note_en: £5 is read five pounds; informally, quid.

def: money in America; $
example: This T-shirt costs twenty dollars.
note_ru: В разговоре — bucks.
note_en: Informally: bucks.

def: money in many countries in Europe; €
example: The ticket costs ten euros.
note_ru: Во множественном числе — euros.
note_en: The plural is euros.

def: a small round piece of metal money
example: I have some coins in my bag.
example_ru: У меня в сумке есть монеты.

def: a small plastic thing; you pay with it
example: I pay with my card.
note_ru: Bank card — банковская карта; birthday card — открытка.
note_en: Bank card; birthday card.

def: money in coins and paper, not a card
example: Cash or card?
note_ru: Pay in cash — платить наличными.
note_en: Pay in cash.

def: you put things in it and carry it
example: Do you want a bag?

def: to use money to buy things
example: I spend a lot of money on clothes.
example_ru: Я трачу много денег на одежду.
note_ru: Spend money on — тратить деньги на; spend time — проводить время.
note_en: Spend money on something; spend time somewhere.

def: you do not pay for it
example: The park is free.
note_ru: Также «свободный»: Are you free tonight? — Ты свободен сегодня вечером?
note_en: Also "not busy": Are you free tonight?

def: you can go in; not closed
example: Is the shop open on Sunday?

def: you cannot go in; not open
example: The bank is closed today.

def: you ask it to know the price
example: How much is this bag?
note_ru: How much — с неисчисляемыми (money, water), how many — с исчисляемыми.
note_en: How much goes with uncountable nouns (money, water), how many with countable ones.

def: going to shops and buying things
example: I go shopping on Saturday.
example_ru: В субботу я хожу за покупками.
note_ru: Go shopping — ходить по магазинам; do the shopping — покупать продукты.
note_en: Go shopping means to visit shops; do the shopping means to buy food and household things.

def: words you write one under the other
example: Milk and eggs are on my shopping list.
example_ru: Молоко и яйца в моём списке покупок.

def: a place where children learn
example: My son goes to school at eight.
example_ru: Мой сын идёт в школу в восемь.
note_ru: Go to school, at school — без артикля.
note_en: Go to school, at school, with no article.

def: a person who helps children learn at school
example: Our teacher is very nice.

def: a person who learns at school or university
example: There are twenty students in my class.
note_ru: Student — и школьник, и студент.
note_en: Student can mean a school pupil or a university student.

def: a group of students; a lesson
example: My English class is at ten.
example_ru: Моё занятие по английскому в десять.
note_ru: Классная комната — classroom.
note_en: The room is a classroom.

def: a time when a teacher teaches you
example: The lesson is forty minutes long.

def: pages with words in it; you read it
example: I read a book every week.
note_ru: Также глагол: book a ticket — забронировать билет.
note_en: Also a verb: book a ticket.

def: you write with it
example: Can I have your pen?

def: you write or draw with it; it is made of wood
example: I draw with a pencil.

def: you write on it; books are made of it
example: I need some paper.
note_ru: A piece of paper — лист бумаги; a paper — газета.
note_en: A piece of paper is one sheet; a paper is also a newspaper.

def: a table where you write or work
example: My computer is on my desk.

def: work from school that you do at home
example: I do my homework in the evening.
note_ru: Неисчисляемое: do homework, а не make homeworks.
note_en: Uncountable: do homework, not make homeworks.

def: questions to see what you know
example: We have an English test on Friday.
example_ru: В пятницу у нас контрольная по английскому.
note_ru: Сдавать тест — take a test.
note_en: Take a test.

def: you say or write it; «cat» is a word
example: I learn ten new words a day.
example_ru: Я учу десять новых слов в день.

def: you ask it to know something
example: Can I ask a question?
note_ru: Задавать вопрос — ask a question.
note_en: Ask a question.

def: what you say after a question
example: The answer is yes.
note_ru: Буква w не читается.
note_en: The letter w is silent.

def: to get to know something new
example: I learn English at school.
note_ru: Также learned; учить кого-то — teach.
note_en: Also learned; to give lessons is teach.

def: to help people learn something
example: My mother teaches English.

def: to say a question
example: Ask the teacher.
note_ru: Ask for help — попросить о помощи.
note_en: Ask for help.

def: to speak after a question
example: Please answer my question.
note_ru: Без предлога: answer the question, а не answer on.
note_en: No preposition: answer the question, not answer on.

def: the work you do for money
example: My brother has a new job.
note_ru: Job — исчисляемое (a job), work — нет.
note_en: Job is countable (a job), work is not.

def: a room where people work at desks
example: I work in an office in the city centre.
example_ru: Я работаю в офисе в центре города.

def: the person you work for
example: My boss is a nice woman.

def: a machine for work and the internet
example: I work on a computer all day.
example_ru: Я работаю за компьютером весь день.
note_ru: Ударение на второй слог: comPUter.
note_en: The stress is on the second syllable: comPUter.

def: a letter you send from a computer
example: I send an email to my boss.
example_ru: Я отправляю письмо начальнику по электронной почте.
note_ru: Также глагол: email me — напиши мне на почту.
note_en: Also a verb: email me.

def: a place where people study after school
example: My sister is at university.
note_ru: At university — без артикля; a university — с артиклем a, не an.
note_en: At university, no article; a university with a, not an.

def: a thing you like to do in your free time
example: My hobby is music.

def: songs and sounds that you listen to
example: I listen to music every day.
note_ru: Listen to music — с предлогом to.
note_en: Listen to music, with the preposition to.

def: music with words that you sing
example: This is my favourite song.

def: to make music with your voice
example: My daughter sings very well.
note_ru: Singer — певец.
note_en: A singer is a person who sings.

def: to move your body to music
example: We dance at the party.

def: to have fun with a game or sport
example: The children play in the garden.
note_ru: Play football (без артикля), но play the guitar (с the).
note_en: Play football (no article), but play the guitar (with the).

def: a thing you play, like football or chess
example: Let's play a game!
note_ru: Computer game — компьютерная игра.
note_en: Computer game.

def: a game with a ball and two teams of eleven
example: I play football with my friends.
example_ru: Я играю в футбол с друзьями.
note_ru: В США — soccer; American football — другая игра.
note_en: In the US: soccer; American football is a different game.

def: football, tennis and swimming are sports
example: My favourite sport is football.
note_ru: Заниматься спортом — do sport / play sports.
note_en: Do sport / play sports.

def: a story you watch on TV or at the cinema
example: We watch a film on Saturday evening.
example_ru: В субботу вечером мы смотрим фильм.
note_ru: В американском английском — movie.
note_en: In American English: movie.

def: to look at something for some time
example: I watch TV in the evening.
note_ru: Watch TV, но look at a picture, see a film.
note_en: Watch TV, but look at a picture and see a film.

def: to hear music or a person with care
example: I listen to music on the bus.
note_ru: С предлогом to: listen to music. Буква t не читается.
note_en: With the preposition to: listen to music. The letter t is silent.

def: to move in water
example: I swim in the sea in summer.
note_ru: Go swimming — ходить плавать.
note_en: Go swimming means to go for a swim.

def: people meet to eat, dance and have fun
example: Come to my party on Saturday!
example_ru: Приходи на мою вечеринку в субботу!
note_ru: Birthday party — день рождения (праздник).
note_en: Birthday party.

def: days when you do not work and you rest
example: We go to Spain on holiday.
example_ru: Мы едем в Испанию в отпуск.
note_ru: В США — vacation; on holiday — в отпуске.
note_en: In the US: vacation; on holiday means away on a trip or not working.

def: a drawing, painting or photo
example: There is a picture of a cat in my room.
example_ru: В моей комнате есть картинка с кошкой.
note_ru: Take a picture — сфотографировать.
note_en: Take a picture means to photograph something.

def: a picture you take with a camera or phone
example: This is a photo of my family.
note_ru: Полная форма — photograph.
note_en: The full form is photograph.

def: to make a picture with a pen or pencil
example: My son likes to draw animals.
note_ru: Draw — карандашом или ручкой; paint — красками.
note_en: Draw is with a pencil or pen; paint is with paints.

def: you call people and send messages with it
example: My phone is in my bag.
note_ru: Mobile phone — мобильный; в США — cell phone.
note_en: Mobile phone; in the US, cell phone.

def: to go to other towns and countries
example: I love to travel.
note_ru: Travel by train — ехать на поезде.
note_en: Travel by train.

def: to sit on a bike or horse and go
example: I ride my bike in the park.
example_ru: Я катаюсь на велосипеде в парке.
note_ru: Ride a bike, но drive a car.
note_en: Ride a bike, but drive a car.

def: a place with sand next to the sea
example: We go to the beach in summer.

def: a thing with six strings; you play music on it
example: My brother plays the guitar.
note_ru: Play the guitar — с артиклем the.
note_en: Play the guitar, with the article the.

def: to see and speak to a person
example: I meet my friends at the café.
example_ru: Я встречаюсь с друзьями в кафе.
note_ru: Без предлога: meet a friend, а не meet with.
note_en: No preposition needed: meet a friend, not meet with.

def: a good time; you like it
example: The party was fun!
note_ru: Have fun! — Повеселись! Funny — смешной.
note_en: Have fun! Funny means "making you laugh".

def: a dog, a cat or a horse is an animal
example: My favourite animal is the horse.

def: an animal that lives with people and says «woof»
example: I walk my dog every morning.
example_ru: Я гуляю с собакой каждое утро.

def: a small animal that lives with people and says «miaow»
example: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.

def: an animal that can fly and sing
example: Birds sing in the morning.

def: a big animal; people ride it
example: My uncle has two horses.

def: a big animal that gives milk
example: The cows are in the field.

def: a fat pink animal on a farm
example: The pig is eating.
note_ru: Мясо свиньи — pork.
note_en: The meat of a pig is pork.

def: a farm animal with white or black wool
example: There are many sheep in the field.
note_ru: Множественное число — тоже sheep.
note_en: The plural is also sheep.

def: a very small grey animal with a long tail
example: The cat sees a mouse.
note_ru: Множественное число — mice; компьютерная мышь — тоже mouse.
note_en: The plural is mice; a computer mouse is also a mouse.

def: a small animal with long ears
example: My sister has a white rabbit.

def: a big plant with leaves; apples grow on it
example: There is a big tree in our garden.

def: the beautiful part of a plant, often red or yellow
example: I give flowers to my mum.

def: the green plant on the ground in parks
example: The children sit on the grass.

def: a big place with many trees
example: We walk in the forest on Sundays.
example_ru: По воскресеньям мы гуляем в лесу.
note_ru: Небольшой лес — wood / woods.
note_en: A small forest is a wood / woods.

def: a long line of water that goes to the sea
example: The river is near our town.

def: a very big place with salt water
example: I like to swim in the sea.
note_ru: Звучит так же, как see (видеть).
note_en: Sounds the same as see.

def: a big place of water with land around it
example: We swim in the lake in summer.

def: a very high hill
example: There is snow on the mountains.
note_ru: В горах — in the mountains.
note_en: In the mountains.

def: a big place with grass and no trees
example: The horses are in the field.

def: trees, animals, rivers and mountains
example: I love nature.
note_ru: Без артикля: in nature, не in the nature.
note_en: No article: in nature, not in the nature.

def: you see it in the sky at night
example: The moon is big tonight.
note_ru: С артиклем: the moon.
note_en: With the article: the moon.

def: a small light in the sky at night
example: I can see the stars.
note_ru: Также «звезда» о знаменитости: a film star.
note_en: Also a famous person: a film star.

def: a thing that grows in the ground, like a flower
example: I have many plants in my room.
example_ru: У меня в комнате много растений.
note_ru: Также глагол: plant a tree — посадить дерево.
note_en: Also a verb: plant a tree.

def: a green part of a tree or plant
example: The leaves are yellow in autumn.
note_ru: Множественное число — leaves; лист бумаги — a sheet of paper.
note_en: The plural is leaves; a leaf of paper is usually a sheet of paper.

def: the Earth; all countries and people
example: I want to see the world.
note_ru: С артиклем: the world. Мир (не война) — peace.
note_en: With the article: the world. The opposite of war is peace.

def: I am, you are, he is
example: I am a student. She is my sister.
forms: be – was/were – been; am, is, are
note_ru: В русском «быть» часто не переводится: I am a doctor — Я врач.
note_en: Russian often drops "to be" in the present, but English needs it: I am a doctor.

def: something is yours
example: I have two cats.
note_ru: «У меня есть» — I have; have breakfast — завтракать.
note_en: I have = I own something; have breakfast means to eat breakfast.

def: to make an action; to work at something
example: What do you do at the weekend?
note_ru: Do также помогает задать вопрос: Do you like tea?
note_en: Do also helps to form questions: Do you like tea?

def: to move from one place to another place
example: I go to work by bus.
example_ru: Я езжу на работу на автобусе.
note_ru: Go to school, go home (без to), go shopping.
note_en: Go to school, go home (no to), go shopping.

def: to move to the place where I am
example: Come to my party on Friday!
example_ru: Приходи на мою вечеринку в пятницу!
note_ru: Come here! — Иди сюда! Go — туда, come — сюда.
note_en: Come here! Go is away from the speaker, come is towards the speaker.

def: to cook or build something new
example: My mum makes a cake every Sunday.
example_ru: Моя мама печёт торт каждое воскресенье.
note_ru: Make tea, make a cake, make friends; но do homework.
note_en: Make tea, make a cake, make friends; but do homework.

def: to use your eyes
example: I can see a bird in the tree.
note_ru: See you! — Пока, увидимся!
note_en: See you! is an informal goodbye.

def: to take something that someone gives you
example: I get many emails every day.
example_ru: Я получаю много писем каждый день.
note_ru: Get home — добраться домой; get up — вставать; get cold — замёрзнуть.
note_en: Get home = arrive home; get up = rise from bed; get cold = become cold.

def: to put your hand on something and have it
example: Take your umbrella, it is raining.
note_ru: Take a bus — поехать на автобусе; take a photo — сфотографировать.
note_en: Take a bus = travel by bus; take a photo = photograph something.

def: to put something in another person's hand
example: Give me the book, please.
note_ru: Give me the pen = give the pen to me.
note_en: Give me the pen = give the pen to me.

def: to have something in your head; to be sure
example: I know his name.
note_ru: Буква k не читается: /nəʊ/, как no.
note_en: The letter k is silent: /nəʊ/, like no.

def: to speak words
example: What do you say in English?
note_ru: Said читается /sed/, says — /sez/. Say something to someone.
note_en: Said is pronounced /sed/, says /sez/. Say something to someone.

def: to say words; to use a language
example: I speak English and Russian.
note_ru: Speak English — говорить по-английски (без предлога).
note_en: Speak English (no preposition).

def: to use your head; to have an idea
example: I think it is a good film.
note_ru: I think so — Думаю, да. Think about — думать о.
note_en: I think so = I believe that is true. Think about something.

def: to put food in your mouth
example: We eat dinner at seven.
note_ru: Ate читается /et/ или /eɪt/.
note_en: Ate is pronounced /et/ or /eɪt/.

def: to put water, tea or juice in your mouth
example: I drink a lot of water.
note_ru: A drink — напиток.
note_en: A drink is something you drink.

def: to need and like something very much
example: I want a cup of tea.
note_ru: Want to do — хотеть что-то сделать: I want to sleep.
note_en: Want to do: I want to sleep.

def: to think that something is good or nice
example: I like coffee.
note_ru: «Мне нравится» — I like (я — подлежащее).
note_en: In English the person who likes is the subject: I like it.

def: to have your home in a place
example: I live in a small flat.
note_ru: Live in London, live with my parents.
note_en: Live in London, live with my parents.

def: you must have something
example: I need a new phone.
note_ru: «Мне нужно» — I need: I need a pen, I need to go.
note_en: I need a pen, I need to go.

def: to turn your eyes to something
example: Look at this picture!
note_ru: Look at — смотреть на; look for — искать; you look tired — ты выглядишь усталым.
note_en: Look at = direct your eyes to; look for = search; you look tired = you seem tired.

def: to do something good for another person
example: Can you help me, please?
note_ru: Help someone — без предлога: help me, а не help to me.
note_en: No preposition: help me, not help to me.

def: to say something to a person
example: Tell me about your family.
note_ru: Tell me (без to), но say to me.
note_en: Tell me (no to), but say to me.

def: to see something after you look for it
example: I can't find my keys.

def: you know how to do it; it is OK to do it
example: I can swim. Can you?
note_ru: После can — глагол без to: I can swim, не I can to swim.
note_en: After can, use the verb without to: I can swim, not I can to swim.

def: to look at words and understand them
example: I read a book in the evening.
note_ru: Прошедшее время пишется так же, но читается /red/.
note_en: The past form is spelled the same but pronounced /red/.

def: to make words with a pen
example: I write an email to my friend.
note_ru: Буква w не читается: /raɪt/, как right.
note_en: The letter w is silent: /raɪt/, like right.

def: to move a door or window so people can go in
example: Open your books, please.

def: to move a door or window so it is not open
example: Close the window, it is cold.
note_ru: Глагол читается /kləʊz/, прилагательное close (близкий) — /kləʊs/.
note_en: The verb is pronounced /kləʊz/, the adjective close (near) is /kləʊs/.

def: to be on a chair, not stand
example: Sit down, please.
note_ru: Sit down — садиться; sit on a chair — сидеть на стуле.
note_en: Sit down = take a seat; sit on a chair.

def: to be on your feet, not sit
example: The children stand near the door.
note_ru: Stand up — вставать.
note_en: Stand up = rise to your feet.

def: to stay in a place until someone comes
example: Wait for me, please!
note_ru: Wait for someone — ждать кого-то (с предлогом for).
note_en: Wait for someone (with the preposition for).

def: to do something to see if you can
example: Try this cake, it is very good.
example_ru: Попробуй этот торт, он очень вкусный.
note_ru: Try to do — пытаться сделать; try on — примерять одежду.
note_en: Try to do something; try on clothes to see if they fit.

def: to do something with a thing
example: Can I use your phone?
note_ru: Глагол читается /juːz/, существительное use — /juːs/.
note_en: The verb is pronounced /juːz/, the noun use is /juːs/.

def: to like something or someone very, very much
example: I love my family.
note_ru: Love — сильнее, чем like.
note_en: Love is stronger than like.

def: to know what words or a person mean
example: I don't understand this word.
note_ru: I see — тоже «понятно».
note_en: I see also means "I understand".

def: to have something in your head from before
example: I remember your name.
note_ru: Без предлога: remember the word, не remember about.
note_en: No preposition: remember the word, not remember about.

def: to not remember
example: Don't forget your keys!

def: to make a letter or email go to someone
example: I send a photo to my mum.
note_ru: Send me a message — пришли мне сообщение.
note_en: Send me a message.

def: to come with something in your hands
example: Bring your friends to the party!
note_ru: Bring — сюда, take — туда.
note_en: Bring is towards the speaker, take is away from the speaker.

def: to go away from a place
example: The train leaves at nine.
note_ru: Leave home — уходить из дома; leave the keys — оставить ключи.
note_en: Leave home = go out of your home; leave the keys = not take them with you.

def: to let someone see something
example: Show me your photos!

def: to get sounds with your ears
example: I can hear music.
note_ru: Heard читается /hɜːd/. Hear — слышать, listen — слушать.
note_en: Heard is pronounced /hɜːd/. Hear is to notice sounds, listen is to pay attention to them.

def: to look happy with your mouth
example: The baby smiles at me.
note_ru: Smile at someone — улыбаться кому-то.
note_en: Smile at someone.

def: to make a happy sound: ha ha!
example: We laugh at his jokes.
note_ru: Читается /lɑːf/ — gh как «ф».
note_en: Pronounced /lɑːf/: gh sounds like f.

def: water comes from your eyes when you are sad
example: The baby is crying.
note_ru: Также «кричать»: cry for help — звать на помощь.
note_en: Also "to shout": cry for help.

def: to move in the sky like a bird or plane
example: We fly to Paris tomorrow.
note_ru: A fly — муха.
note_en: A fly is also an insect.

def: to go left or right; to move round
example: Turn left at the bank.
note_ru: Turn on / turn off — включать / выключать.
note_en: Turn on / turn off = switch on / switch off.

def: to not go away from a place
example: We stay at home on Sunday.
note_ru: Stay in a hotel — жить в отеле.
note_en: Stay in a hotel.

def: to come to a place; to get there
example: The train arrives at six.
note_ru: Arrive in London (город), arrive at the station (место).
note_en: Arrive in London (a city), arrive at the station (a place).

def: not small; of a large size
example: London is a big city.

def: not big; little
example: I have a small car.
note_ru: Также little: a little cat.
note_en: Also little: a little cat.

def: nice; not bad
example: This is a good book.
note_ru: Хорошо (наречие) — well: I speak English well.
note_en: The adverb is well: I speak English well.

def: not good
example: The weather is bad today.

def: not old; from a short time ago
example: I have a new phone.
note_ru: Звучит так же, как knew (знал).
note_en: Sounds the same as knew (past of know).

def: not new; not young
example: My grandfather is old.
note_ru: Возраст: How old are you? — Сколько тебе лет?
note_en: Age: How old are you?

def: not old; of a small age
example: My teacher is young.
note_ru: Читается /jʌŋ/, без «г» на конце.
note_en: Pronounced /jʌŋ/, with no g sound at the end.

def: you feel very good
example: I am happy today.
note_ru: Happy birthday! — С днём рождения!
note_en: Happy birthday!

def: not happy; you want to cry
example: She is sad because her cat is ill.
example_ru: Ей грустно, потому что её кошка болеет.

def: very nice to look at
example: What a beautiful dress!
note_ru: Beautiful — о женщинах и вещах; о мужчинах говорят handsome.
note_en: Beautiful is used for women and things; for men people say handsome.

def: good; you like it
example: Your mum is very nice.
note_ru: Nice day — хороший день; nice people — приятные люди.
note_en: Nice day; nice people.

def: not short; from here to far away
example: She has long hair.
note_ru: A long day — долгий день.
note_en: A long day.

def: not long; not tall
example: My brother is short.
note_ru: О росте — short, не low.
note_en: For height use short, not low.

def: a tall person has long legs and a high head
example: My father is very tall.
note_ru: О людях и деревьях — tall; о горах — high.
note_en: Tall is for people and trees; high is for mountains.

def: not slow; it moves very quickly
example: This car is very fast.
note_ru: Также наречие: he runs fast — он бегает быстро.
note_en: Also an adverb: he runs fast.

def: not fast
example: The old bus is slow.
note_ru: Медленно — slowly.
note_en: The adverb is slowly.

def: not difficult; you can do it
example: This test is easy.
note_ru: Лёгкий (по весу) — light, не easy.
note_en: For weight, the opposite of heavy is light, not easy.

def: not easy
example: English is not difficult.
note_ru: Также hard: a hard question.
note_en: Also hard: a hard question.

def: with a lot of power in your body
example: My father is very strong.
note_ru: Strong coffee — крепкий кофе.
note_en: Strong coffee.

def: after the right time
example: Sorry, I am late.
note_ru: Be late for work — опаздывать на работу.
note_en: Be late for work.

def: you want to eat
example: I am hungry. Let's have lunch.
note_ru: «Я хочу есть» — I am hungry (с be, не have).
note_en: I am hungry (with be, not have).

def: you want to sleep or rest
example: I am tired after work.
note_ru: «Я устал» — I am tired.
note_en: I am tired.

def: you have a lot of work to do
example: I am busy today.
note_ru: Читается /ˈbɪzi/ — u как «и».
note_en: Pronounced /ˈbɪzi/: the u sounds like i.

def: you can start now
example: Dinner is ready!
note_ru: Are you ready? — Ты готов?
note_en: Are you ready?

def: you want to know more about it
example: This book is very interesting.
note_ru: Interesting — о вещах; interested — о людях: I am interested.
note_en: Interesting describes things; interested describes people: I am interested.

def: you ask it about a thing
example: What is this?
note_ru: What colour? — какого цвета?; What time? — во сколько?
note_en: What colour?; What time?

def: you ask it about a person
example: Who is that man?
note_ru: Буква w не читается: /huː/.
note_en: The letter w is silent: /huː/.

def: you ask it about a place
example: Where do you live?
note_ru: Where are you from? — Откуда ты?
note_en: Where are you from?

def: you ask it about a time
example: When is your birthday?

def: you ask it to know the reason
example: Why are you sad?
note_ru: Ответ начинают с because — потому что.
note_en: The answer usually starts with because.

def: you ask it about the way you do something
example: How do you go to work?
note_ru: How old? — сколько лет?; How much? — сколько стоит?
note_en: How old?; How much?

def: you ask it to choose one of two or more things
example: Which bag is yours?
note_ru: Which — когда выбор из известных вариантов; what — в общем.
note_en: Which is for a choice between known options; what is more general.

def: you ask it about a number
example: How many brothers do you have?
note_ru: How many — с исчисляемыми (books, people), how much — с неисчисляемыми.
note_en: How many goes with countable nouns (books, people), how much with uncountable ones.

def: the person who is speaking
example: I am from Russia.
note_ru: Всегда с большой буквы, даже в середине предложения.
note_en: Always a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.

def: the person I am speaking to
example: You are my friend.
note_ru: You — и «ты», и «вы»; всегда you are, не you is.
note_en: You is both singular and plural; always you are, not you is.

def: a man or boy
example: He is my brother.
note_ru: Только о людях (и домашних животных); о предметах — it.
note_en: Only for people (and pets); for things use it.

def: a woman or girl
example: She is a doctor.

def: a thing or an animal
example: This is my car. It is new.
note_ru: О погоде и времени тоже it: It is cold. It is five o'clock.
note_en: Also for weather and time: It is cold. It is five o'clock.

def: I and other people
example: We live in Moscow.

def: other people or things; not we, not you
example: They are my parents.
note_ru: О людях и о предметах: the books — they.
note_en: For people and for things: the books = they.

def: you use it for «I» after a verb
example: Call me tomorrow.
note_ru: Give me, help me, with me — после глагола и предлога.
note_en: Give me, help me, with me: after a verb or preposition.

def: you use it for «he» after a verb
example: I know him.

def: you use it for «she» after a verb; also «of she»
example: I see her every day. Her name is Anna.
example_ru: Я вижу её каждый день. Её зовут Анна.
note_ru: Her — и «её» (объект), и «её» (чья): her book.
note_en: Her is both an object (I see her) and a possessive (her book).

def: you use it for «they» after a verb
example: I like them.

def: of me; it is mine
example: This is my house.
note_ru: My, your, his, her — всегда перед существительным.
note_en: My, your, his, her always come before a noun.

def: of you
example: Is this your bag?
note_ru: Не путайте с you're (= you are).
note_en: Don't confuse it with you're (= you are).

def: of him
example: His car is red.

def: of us
example: Our flat is small.
note_ru: Читается как hour: /ˈaʊə/.
note_en: Pronounced like hour: /ˈaʊə/.

def: the thing here, near me
example: This is my brother.
note_ru: Множественное число — these (/ðiːz/): these books.
note_en: The plural is these (/ðiːz/): these books.

def: the thing there, not near me
example: That is my school.
note_ru: Множественное число — those (/ðəʊz/).
note_en: The plural is those (/ðəʊz/).

def: inside a place or thing
example: The milk is in the fridge.
note_ru: In London, in the morning, in May, in winter.
note_en: In London, in the morning, in May, in winter.

def: on top of a thing
example: The book is on the table.
note_ru: On Monday, on the wall, on the bus.
note_en: On Monday, on the wall, on the bus.

def: in a place; at a time
example: I am at home at six.
note_ru: At six o'clock, at school, at the weekend, at night.
note_en: At six o'clock, at school, at the weekend, at night.

def: in the direction of a place
example: I go to the park.
note_ru: Go to school, но go home (без to). Обычно читается слабо: /tə/.
note_en: Go to school, but go home (no to). Usually pronounced weakly: /tə/.

def: the place where something starts
example: I am from Russia.
note_ru: From nine to five — с девяти до пяти.
note_en: From nine to five.

def: together; not alone
example: I live with my parents.
note_ru: Tea with milk — чай с молоком.
note_en: Tea with milk.

def: a part of; it says what thing it is
example: A cup of tea, please.
note_ru: Читается /əv/: a photo of my family — фото моей семьи.
note_en: Pronounced /əv/: a photo of my family.

def: below; not on top
example: The cat is under the table.

def: at the side of
example: The bank is next to the hotel.
note_ru: Также beside.
note_en: Also beside.

def: in the middle of two things
example: The café is between the bank and the shop.

def: at the back of
example: The garden is behind the house.

def: not behind; before
example: The car is in front of the house.
note_ru: Три слова: in front of.
note_en: Three words: in front of.

def: not far from
example: I live near the station.
note_ru: Без предлога после near: near the park, не near to.
note_en: No preposition after near: near the park, not near to.

def: you use it to put two things together
example: I like tea and coffee.
note_ru: Обычно читается слабо: /ənd/ или /n/.
note_en: Usually pronounced weakly: /ənd/ or /n/.

def: you use it to say something different
example: I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
example_ru: Я люблю чай, но не люблю кофе.

def: you use it to give two things to choose
example: Tea or coffee?

def: you use it to say why
example: I am happy because it is Friday.
example_ru: Я счастлив, потому что сегодня пятница.
note_ru: Because — ответ на why.
note_en: Because answers the question why.

def: you use it to say «no» in a sentence
example: I am not tired.
note_ru: Коротко: isn't, don't, can't.
note_en: Short forms: isn't, don't, can't.

def: a lot; more than usual
example: This cake is very good.
note_ru: Very much — очень (после глагола): I like it very much.
note_en: Very much goes after the verb: I like it very much.

def: also; or more than is good
example: I like music too.
note_ru: В конце предложения — «тоже»; перед прилагательным — «слишком»: too big.
note_en: At the end of a sentence it means "also"; before an adjective it means "more than is good": too big.

def: in this place
example: Come here, please.
note_ru: Here you are. — Вот, возьмите.
note_en: Here you are. = said when you give someone something.

def: in that place, not here
example: My bag is there, on the chair.
note_ru: There is / there are — есть, находится: There is a cat on the sofa.
note_en: There is / there are says that something exists or is somewhere: There is a cat on the sofa.

def: every time; all the time
example: I always have breakfast at eight.
note_ru: Стоит перед глаголом, но после be: I am always late.
note_en: Goes before the main verb, but after be: I am always late.

def: you use it before a thing we both know
example: The book is on the table.
note_ru: Перед гласным звуком читается /ðiː/: the apple.
note_en: Before a vowel sound it is pronounced /ðiː/: the apple.

def: you use it before one thing, not a special one
example: I have a dog and a cat.
example_ru: У меня есть собака и кошка.
note_ru: Перед гласным звуком — an: an apple, an hour.
note_en: Before a vowel sound use an: an apple, an hour.

def: a person whose job is to stop bad people
example: A police officer is standing near the station.
note_ru: Сейчас говорят «police officer», а не «policeman», чтобы слово подходило и мужчинам, и женщинам.
note_en: Today people say "police officer" rather than "policeman", so the word fits both men and women.

def: a person who drives a car, bus or taxi
example: My uncle is a bus driver.

def: a person who cooks food in a restaurant
example: The cook in this restaurant is very good.
example_ru: Повар в этом ресторане очень хороший.
note_ru: Не путайте с «cooker» — это кухонная плита, а не человек.
note_en: Don't confuse it with "cooker": that is a kitchen stove, not a person.

def: a person who helps you in a shop
example: The shop assistant helps me find a jacket.

def: a person who has animals and grows food
example: The farmer has ten cows and a horse.
example_ru: У фермера десять коров и лошадь.

def: a person who makes houses
example: The builders start work at seven o'clock.
example_ru: Строители начинают работу в семь часов.

def: a person who works, often with their hands
example: The workers eat lunch at twelve.

def: a person who makes machines, roads or bridges
example: My sister is an engineer in a big company.
example_ru: Моя сестра — инженер в большой компании.

def: a person who helps in an office with letters and calls
example: The secretary answers the phone in the office.
example_ru: Секретарь отвечает на звонки в офисе.

def: a person whose job is to clean rooms
example: The cleaner comes to the office every evening.
example_ru: Уборщица приходит в офис каждый вечер.

def: a person who flies a plane
example: The pilot says hello to the people on the plane.

def: a person who draws or paints pictures
example: The artist draws beautiful pictures of the sea.
note_ru: Ложный друг: «artist» — это художник, а не артист. Артист (актёр) — «actor».
note_en: False friend for Russian speakers: an "artist" paints or draws; a stage performer is an "actor".

def: a person who sings songs
example: She is a famous singer in our country.
example_ru: Она известная певица в нашей стране.

def: a person who plays people in films
example: My favourite actor is in this new film.
example_ru: Мой любимый актёр играет в этом новом фильме.
note_ru: Женщина-актёр — «actress», но сейчас «actor» часто говорят про всех.
note_en: A female actor can be called an "actress", but today "actor" is often used for everyone.

def: a person who writes books
example: This writer has a new book about London.
example_ru: У этого писателя новая книга о Лондоне.

def: a person who cuts and washes hair
example: I go to the hairdresser every month.
example_ru: Я хожу к парикмахеру каждый месяц.

def: a person who repairs cars
example: The mechanic is looking at my old car.

def: a person whose job is to stop fires
example: The firefighters are very fast and strong.

def: a person who brings letters to your house
example: The postman comes at nine every morning.
example_ru: Почтальон приходит каждое утро в девять.
note_ru: Британское слово; в США говорят «mail carrier» или «mailman».
note_en: A British word; in the US people say "mail carrier" or "mailman".

def: a person who makes bread and cakes
example: The baker makes fresh bread every day.
example_ru: Пекарь каждый день печёт свежий хлеб.

def: a big building where people make things
example: My father works in a car factory.
example_ru: Мой отец работает на автомобильном заводе.
note_ru: По-русски говорят «работать на заводе», но по-английски — «work in / at a factory».
note_en: Use "in" or "at": "work in / at a factory".

def: a business that sells things or does work
example: She works for a big computer company.
example_ru: Она работает в большой компьютерной компании.
note_ru: «Работать в компании» — «work for a company» (с предлогом for).
note_en: "Work for a company" (with the preposition for).

def: when people come together to talk about work
example: We have a meeting at ten o'clock today.
example_ru: У нас сегодня собрание в десять часов.

def: the job you do, or the place you do it
example: I go to work by bus every day.
example_ru: Я каждый день езжу на работу на автобусе.
note_ru: «Work» — неисчисляемое: нельзя сказать «a work». Одно место работы — «a job».
note_en: "Work" is uncountable: you can't say "a work". One position is "a job".

def: a place where you send letters
example: The post office is next to the bank.

def: the room near the front door of a house
example: Please leave your shoes in the hall.
note_ru: В доме «hall» — это прихожая, а не большой зал.
note_en: In a house, the "hall" is the entrance area, not a big hall.

def: a small room where you go to the loo
example: Excuse me, where is the toilet?
note_ru: В Британии «toilet» — обычное слово; в США говорят «bathroom» или «restroom».
note_en: In Britain "toilet" is the normal word; in the US people say "bathroom" or "restroom".

def: a big thing you fill with water and sit in
example: The children have a bath every evening.

def: a thing in the bathroom where water falls on you
example: The shower in the hotel is very hot.

def: a small brush for your teeth
example: My toothbrush is blue, and yours is green.
example_ru: Моя зубная щётка синяя, а твоя — зелёная.

def: a thing you use with water to wash
example: Wash your hands with soap and water.
example_ru: Мой руки с мылом и водой.

def: a thing in a room that helps you see
example: Please turn on the light. It's dark here.

def: a thing you put rubbish in
example: Put the old paper in the bin, please.
example_ru: Положи старую бумагу в мусорное ведро, пожалуйста.
note_ru: Британское слово; в США говорят «trash can» или «garbage can».
